_comment: Round 40. Machine-readable twin of docs/DEBT_STAGE_B_TRIAGE.md. Each entry is a Stage B finding that has been dispositioned (fixed with verified source, fixed with source named but not yet quoted, flagged as a case-law gloss awaiting counsel, covered elsewhere, or HORIZON). The corroboration runner passes a node's entries into the Stage B prompt and asks the model to tag any overlapping edge case with the matching id; only UNTAGGED material findings count toward the gate (ratified 2026-09-04). Adding an entry here is a disposition decision, not a content edit: it requires the finding to have been actually addressed in the rules file or explicitly accepted for counsel review. The docs file remains the human-readable queue of record; keep the two in sync.
